description: This script automates the process of fetching repositories with a specific topic ('fastapi') from GitHub, compares the data with existing local data, updates a YAML file if necessary, and creates a pull request for the changes. It includes configuration via environment variables or secrets, interacts with GitHub via PyGithub, and manages Git operations through subprocess calls.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Defines configuration settings for GitHub repository and token, using Pydantic's BaseSettings to manage environment variables or secrets.

classes.name: Repo
classes.description: Represents a simplified GitHub repository with selected attributes for downstream processing and YAML serialization.

methods.name: None main()
methods.description: Main function orchestrating repository search, data comparison, YAML update, Git operations, and pull request creation.
